summary:
All context gathered. Producing the plan:

# Plan: PDF Export (jsPDF) — resume-editor

**Inherited decisions honored:** README (PDF export is the product goal; "English or Indonesia as user selected"); Part 2 decisions (export language chosen at export time — PDF is EN *or* ID; JSON always both; lenient import; template `dev-hybrid-id-no-photo`); Part 4 (live preview landed, sheet is pure HTML); Part 5 (JSON import/export done; `ImportExportBar.vue` holds export buttons; `downloadTextFile` util; slug/filename convention; toast pattern).

**Deliberate revision of Part 2 Decision 1** (was: `window.print()` + print CSS, "v1 only; revisit if a text-preserving lib is needed"): the user explicitly commissioned a library search; the research brief picks **jsPDF text-only**, which is text-preserving (ATS-safe per template §5) and deterministic across browsers — so the export workstream now uses jsPDF instead of print-CSS. The `print:hidden` class on the bar stays harmless.

## 1. Library, version, install

- **Pick: jsPDF, text-only API** (`import { jsPDF } from 'jspdf'`). ~330 KB min / **~98 KB gzip** (research §1; `[MEM]` — verify with `npm view jspdf version dist.unpackedSize` before committing). MIT. Actively maintained.
- Install: `bun add jspdf` (latest stable; if 3.x exists, confirm text-only API surface is unchanged: `new jsPDF({unit, format})`, `setFont/setFontSize/setTextColor/setDrawColor/setLineWidth`, `splitTextToSize`, `getTextWidth`, `text`, `textWithLink`, `addPage`, `getNumberOfPages`, `output('arraybuffer')`, `setProperties`).
- **BLOCKER-LEVEL RULE: never call `doc.html()`** — that path rasterizes via html2canvas and violates template §5 (ATS text-in-image). Also never `doc.save()` (harder to test; use `output('arraybuffer')` + existing download util).
- Runner-up (rejected): pdfmake (~430–470 KB gzip) — better layout ergonomics, fails the lightweight criterion. pdf-lib (~90 KB) — no wrap helper, most effort.
- Fonts: **Helvetica (PDF standard-14, WinA...
